BOOK ONE · LESSON 049

At the butcher’s

在肉店

Mrs. Bird buys meat and talks about what her husband likes. 伯德夫人在肉店买肉，并谈论丈夫喜欢吃什么。

49 / 144 LESSONS3 PARTSREAD · WRITE · PRACTISE
01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question

Listen then answer this question.

听录音，然后回答问题。

  1. 1

    BUTCHER

    Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?

    您今天要买点肉吗，伯德夫人？

  2. 2

    MRS. BIRD

    Yes, please.

    是的，我买一点。

  1. 3

    BUTCHER

    Do you want beef or lamb?

    您要牛肉还是要羔羊肉？

  2. 4

    MRS. BIRD

    Beef, please.

    请给我牛肉。

  1. 5

    BUTCHER

    This lamb’s very good.

    这羔羊肉很好。

  2. 6

    MRS. BIRD

    I like lamb, but my husband doesn’t.

    我喜欢羔羊肉，可我丈夫不喜欢。

  1. 7

    BUTCHER

    What about some steak? This is a nice piece.

    来点牛排吗？这块很好。

  2. 8

    MRS. BIRD

    Give me that piece, please.

    就请给我那块吧。

  1. 9

    MRS. BIRD

    And a pound of mince, too.

    再来一磅肉馅。

  1. 10

    BUTCHER

    Do you want a chicken, Mrs. Bird? They’re very nice.

    您要买只鸡吗，伯德夫人？这些鸡很好。

  2. 11

    MRS. BIRD

    No, thank you.

    不要了，谢谢。

  1. 12

    MRS. BIRD

    My husband likes steak, but he doesn’t like chicken.

    我丈夫喜欢牛排，但他不喜欢鸡。

  2. 13

    BUTCHER

    To tell you the truth, Mrs. Bird, I don’t like chicken either!

    说老实话，伯德夫人，我也不喜欢鸡。

butcher /ˈbʊtʃə/

beef /biːf/
n. 牛肉

n. 羔羊肉
husband /ˈhʌzbənd/
n. 丈夫
steak /steɪk/
n. 牛排
mince /mɪns/
n. 肉馅
chicken /ˈtʃɪkən/
n. 鸡

Notes on the text 课文注释

1 Do you want beef or lamb?

是选择疑问句，本句有两项选择，第一选择 beef 念升调，lamb 则读降调。

2 I like lamb, but my husband doesn’t.

句中的 doesn’t 后面省略了 like lamb。用 but 连接的并列句，在后一分句中可以省略与前一分句中相同的谓语动词和宾语。

3 To tell you the truth

To tell you the truth（或 To tell the truth），意思是：“老实说”，“说实话”。

4 I don’t like chicken either.

either 当“也（不）”讲，用在否定句中。肯定句和疑问句中可用 too，在第 7 课和第 31 课中已出现过这样的句子。

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A Dialogue

Read this dialogue. Fill in the missing words.

读对话，填空。

Complete each speaker’s turn. Give missing words in blank order.

B Vocabulary: meat and produce

You can buy these different kinds of meat from a butcher. What are they? You can buy these vegetables and this fruit from a greengrocer. What are they?

写出以下表示肉类的单词。写出以下表示蔬菜和水果的单词。

B Vocabulary: more fruit or vegetables

Can you think of more fruit or vegetables? Write them here.

你能想出更多的水果和菜吗？写在这里。

C Numbers

Write these ordinal numbers in words.

用英语序数词表示以下数字。
